Class NoGameDAO

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.persistence.NoGameDAO
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameDAO
public class NoGameDAO extends Object implements GameDAO
No-op GameDAO used when the server starts without a reachable DBMS.

All write operations (saveMatch(int, int, List, List), deleteMatch(int)) are silent no-ops. getLeaderboard(int) always returns an empty list so EndGameState can detect the "no DB" condition and log an appropriate message instead of throwing. createMatch() returns a counter seeded by setInitialCounter(int) so game IDs remain unique within a session even without a database.
